Tia is from Huntland, TN and moved to Nashville about 6 years ago. She studied at MTSU to become a RN. She's a registered nurse at a local hospital where she gets to help deliver newborns everyday. 

Adam is from Cleveland, OH and moved to Nashville about 9 years ago. He was in the Army for 6 years before moving to Nashville. Has worked with multiple country artists for the last couple of years as a Tour Manager. Now manages a band here in Nashville. 

Tia and Adam got married in July of 2020. We had our sweet baby Holland, June 26th, 2021. We still live in Nashville, TN with no plans to move away. It's been a great city to grow in and become a family. However, we love to travel and see the world! We are glad to not only use AirBnB for our stays as we travel but we love being hosts as well!
